originalEntry.title_zh: Claude 吉祥物游哥伦比亚
originalEntry.author: alarcon7a
originalEntry.description: A 30-second code-only animation where the Claude mascot travels through Colombian landmarks while showing off search, data and coding skills.
originalEntry.description_zh: 30 秒纯代码动画，Claude 吉祥物走过哥伦比亚的几处地标，一路展示搜索、数据分析和写代码的能力。
originalEntry.prompt: Create a 30-second animation entirely in code featuring a travel and capability montage set in Colombia, with the Claude mascot as the main character. The animation showcases Claude exploring iconic Colombian locations while seamlessly demonstrating its evolution and mastery across its skillset since its initial release: processing search queries and maps while traveling through lush Andean coffee landscapes, translating and analyzing data on vibrant colonial streets in Cartagena, and executing complex reasoning and code visualization overlooking the panoramic skyline of Bogotá from Monserrate. Dynamic camera movements, energetic transitions, warm colorful aesthetics, ending in a confident stance in the Cocora Valley surrounded by giant wax palms.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 完全用代码制作一段 30 秒的动画，内容是以哥伦比亚为背景的旅行与能力蒙太奇，由 Claude 吉祥物担任主角。动画展示 Claude 探访哥伦比亚的标志性地点，同时自然地呈现它自首次发布以来在各项技能上的进化与精通：穿行在郁郁葱葱的安第斯咖啡产区时处理搜索查询和地图，在卡塔赫纳色彩鲜艳的殖民时期街道上翻译和分析数据，在蒙塞拉特山俯瞰波哥大全景天际线时进行复杂推理和代码可视化。动感的镜头运动，充满活力的转场，温暖多彩的美术风格，最后在科科拉山谷里、被巨大的蜡棕榈环绕，以自信的姿态收尾。
